mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% in 6 months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as businesses and investors react to the slowdown.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 2% in 3 months and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a robust labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 2% QoQ and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL is rising and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.
